title: CppCon 2015: Timur Doumler “C++ in the Audio Industry”
summary: Timur Doumler's CppCon 2015 talk on how C++ is used in the audio industry. It covers the patterns and tools audio developers rely on, including handling real-time constraints.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an introduction to real-time and low-latency programming in C++ for people getting into audio.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: he goes through real time strategies to keep the response time under around 30ms IIRC
